title: Leer's investigation of magnetic anomalies at Coburn's house

tellings.quote: he wanted me to come over and check out my house and we found all kinds of anomalies, anomalous magnetic fields, um leaves and the uh the trunk of the avocado tree had become magnetized.

plain: At a house in Fillmore, California, leaves and the trunk of an avocado tree had become magnetized, and there were strange magnetic fields all over. That is how Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in people's bodies, describes his own house to Michels, saying Roger Leir asked to come and check it and they found the anomalies together. He gives no date, and if true it would point to something unexplained at his home.
